title: Ojiako Ezenne, warrant chief of Adazi-Nnukwu
first: Ogbuefi Ojiako Ezenne (warrant chief 1914–1921, paramount chief 1921–1944)
text: Holder of the oldest Ozo title of Adazi-Nnukwu, Ojiako Ezenne was appointed warrant chief in 1914 and paramount chief in 1921. On 1 February 1915 he chaired a meeting of forty-five warrant chiefs of the south-east that enacted laws ending slavery there, setting him against the Aro.
